claim_text: The September 13, 2022 Farah superseding indictment, No. 0:22-cr-00124 (ECF 57) paras 12 and 14, recites that Feeding Our Future went from receiving and disbursing approximately $3.4 million in federal funds to sites under its sponsorship in 2019 to nearly $200 million in 2021, and that Feeding Our Future received nearly $18 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds as administrative fees in 2021. These are FOF-sponsor-wide recitals (amount_paid), not the Empire $40 million alleged_loss. They overlap the Bock $250 million charging headline (overlap_group_id fof-network-scheme-size) and must not be added to that headline, to the Empire $40 million, to HSS, or to Mohamed $12 million. The FOF $18 million admin-fee recital is not the ThinkTechAct $18 million from Sponsor A.

supporting_passages.quote: Feeding Our Future went from receiving and disbursing approximately $3.4 million in federal funds to sites under its sponsorship in 2019 to nearly $200 million in 2021.
Feeding Our Future received nearly $18 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds as administrative fees in 2021.

Para 14 FOF 2021 administrative fees. Not ThinkTechAct's $18M from Sponsor A.
